caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the ASR values for three different trigger word insertion strategies across a series of trigger words. The x-axis is labeled "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", and "stunning", arranged in the order specified. The x-axis scale is linear and spans from "bb" to "stunning". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and has a linear scale from 0.2 to 0.9. The y-axis tick labels are regularly spaced at increments of 0.1. The first line, labeled "start," is cyan, uses a circle marker, and shows a solid line. Its value starts at approximately 0.23 at 'bb' and increases to approximately 0.87 at 'stunning.' The second line, labeled "random," is orange, uses an x marker, and displays a solid line. It begins at approximately 0.51 at 'bb' and increases to approximately 0.89 at 'stunning'. The third line, labeled "end," is purple, uses a square marker, and is shown as a solid line. It starts at approximately 0.48 at 'bb' and increases to approximately 0.86 at 'stunning'.
